item.title: Kevin Day’s “A New American Day” Showcases BC’s Instrumental Talent
item.description: Celebrating the 250th anniversary of the United States’ Declaration of Independence signing, composer-pianist Kevin Day brought three Boston College music groups together for “A New American Day” on Feb. 7, illustrating the impressive talent of BC’s music and arts scene.

item.title: Nick Jonas’ ‘Sunday Best’ Is Sweet Despite Spotty Quality
item.description: Despite its sporadic quality, Sunday Best ultimately succeeds as a heartfelt, honest glimpse into Jonas’ journey with diabetes and the nature of his personal relationships.

item.title: “Diabetes Is Beautiful”: How Maria Jové Turned Personal Experience Into Purpose
item.description: “You don’t really know who is out there listening to you,” Jové said. “Always present your most genuine self in every situation, because you never know who you might inspire.”

item.title: A Halfhearted Defense of ‘“Wuthering Heights”’
item.description: Emerald Fennell has decided to take on the nearly impossible venture of creating a Wuthering Heights movie. And the internet is not happy about it.

item.title: BC Is Teaching Students To Cheat
item.description: Boston College needs to crack down on its test-taking environments so students don’t feel forced to choose between their grades and their morals.

item.title: Live From the BU Student Section
item.description: Editorial Cartoonist John Dunn gives a sneak peek into the stands at the Beanpot Final.

item.title: International Tankers Have Become the Pawns in the Chess Match Between World Powers
item.description: Warfare extends far beyond the battlefield and can incorporate tactics that are unconventional to the average soldier. In these turbulent times, rising and established powers are precariously pushing the limits of confrontation.

item.title: Avoidantly in Love
item.description: As someone who grew up naively believing that romance would unexpectedly stumble into my life, it’s hard not to harbor a little resentment as I walk past store windows filled with roses and weave through couples holding hands come February.

item.title: BC Back to Basking in Beanpot Glory With 6–2 Win Over BU
item.description: No. 14 Boston College men's hockey's offense answered the call under the brightest of lights, bringing Beanpot glory back to BC after a decade with a 6–2 win over BU in the 300th edition of the Battle of Comm. Ave.
